summary: King County, WA cabin lookout near Skykomish: built 1920, gone by 1938; site is private land now crossed by power lines, with no remains found.

facts.design: Cabin on the knoll; no tower is described
facts.status_note: Gone by 1938 per the register, firelookout.com and Willhite; power lines cross the site and Willhite found no evidence of the lookout

access.note: Firelookout.com and Willhite both say the site is on private property; Willhite says permission from the landowner or power company is needed to use the easement

visit.trail_note: Willhite's road route reaches a gate with No Trespassing signs; he says the site is private property and permission is needed

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest, per the register)

events.note: Cabin built in 1920 per the register and firelookout.com; Willhite says a cabin from the 1920s
August 5, 1934 Osborne photo survey panoramic images show the cleared knoll and cabin (photos, not a lookout event)
Gone by 1938 per all three sources; none describes how it came down
Registered April 24, 2012 as US 1255, WA 155; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: Firelookout.com gives 1360' and Willhite gives 1,360 feet, and Willhite places the site about 200 vertical feet above the valley floor. The register's 3,300 ft (1,006 m) is the outlier.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 3,300 ft (1,006 m); firelookout.com and Willhite give 1,360 ft. The lower figure fits Willhite's 200 vertical feet above the valley floor, so the correction above favours it.
The register and firelookout.com spell it Proffitts; Willhite spells it Profitts. The site, near Skykomish in King County, is the same.

notes_for_editor: Brief elevation (1005.8 m, from the register's 3,300 ft) conflicts with two other sources; see corrections. Brief access 'unknown' is now private. The brief flags a shared register number; the register page gives only US 1255, WA 155 and I did not trace the other holder. The brief shows the register's agency as U.S. Forest Service, which is accurate for the register, but the land is private now. No staffing source was found.
